logsdb_enterprise_retained_fraction.unit: stored bytes with logsdb + synthetic _source / measured stored bytes
logsdb_enterprise_retained_fraction.derivation: Elastic's published logsdb result: 162.7 GB -> 39.4 GB, a 76% reduction; retained fraction 39.4 / 162.7. Applied to the measured Elasticsearch index and snapshot sizes to give the 'Enterprise logsdb' variant: synthetic _source needs the Enterprise licence. Elastic's 76% is measured against standard index mode; applying it on top of a free-licence logsdb measurement over-credits Elasticsearch, which keeps the comparison conservative. Elastic's docs also say 'up to 60%' (retained 0.40).
logsdb_enterprise_retained_fraction.source: Published by Elastic (logsdb with synthetic _source); applied to the measured sizes. See README, 'Known limits'.
